title: Replay
description: A deterministic input timeline that compiles to a generated Play Mode test (spec §8 'Replays are generated Play Mode tests'). Frame-based, never wall-clock.

timebase.description: The determinism stack, spec §8. captureDeltaTime pins Time.captureDeltaTime so each rendered frame advances game time by a fixed amount regardless of wall clock.

runs.description: Spec §8: every criterion is evaluated across at least 2 runs; disagreement -> unstable, never pass.

atFrame.description: Frame-count based, never WaitForSeconds against wall clock (spec §8 determinism stack, rule 4).

action.description: Required when kind=input_action; an Input System action name resolved through the project's adapter (spec §6, §10 Adapters).

label.description: Required when kind IN (capture_screenshot, named_checkpoint) — becomes the named capture referenced by evidence and the demo evidence matrix.
